data.body: **[P2] Preserve registration-order context initialization.** All factories run before any `onInvocationStart` hook. The refactored OTel plugins now extract context, read `Span.current()`, and create invocation spans in their constructors, so an earlier plugin that installs propagation context in its start hook can no longer affect OTel parenting or sampling. Interleave factory creation with each plugin's start hook, or defer OTel initialization to `onInvocationStart` with safe publication, and add a two-plugin ordering test.
